brief:
Israeli occupation authorities issued demolition notices for four facilities in the Abu al-Nur Bedouin encampment in Jerusalem, the Ma'an news agency reported. The structures targeted in the east Jerusalem settlement face destruction under military orders.

The Abu al-Nur community, located in the occupied territories near Jerusalem, has faced repeated threats of demolition. Palestinian Bedouin communities in the area have long contended with Israeli restrictions on construction and development.
title: Israel orders demolition of four structures in Bedouin community east of Jerusalem
